title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・立ちはだかる絶壁

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black's tremendous effort at the spring Tenno Sho draws a new wave of devoted fans to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After watching her race, Air Groove suggests Kitasan Black and Brusquement finally settle their score at the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Satono Diamond takes second place in an incredibly tight race in the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Massive walls bar their respective paths. Next up for Kitasan Black is the Takarazuka Kinen.
